zh.title: 面向智能体工作流的小型快速决策模型
zh.highlight: 一个用于智能体工作流的小型快速决策模型，可在选项间选择或按量表评分，速度超过大语言模型，并给出校准置信度。
zh.summary: 该 GitHub 仓库获得 1183 颗星并近期有公开活动，描述了一个面向智能体工作流的小型快速决策模型或系统模型。它用于在选项间做选择或按量表评分，声称比大语言模型更快，并为每次决策提供校准后的置信度。值得关注的是，它试图用更轻量的决策组件降低智能体流程中的延迟与调用成本，但当前信息仅来自仓库描述，尚不足以判断实际效果。
zh.failureAnalysis: 真实智能体任务常需要开放式推理和上下文理解，专用小型决策器在边界场景、分布外输入和多步决策中可能不如通用大模型稳健，校准置信度也未必可靠。若接入现有智能体框架需要额外适配、监控和回退机制，工程复杂度可能抵消速度和成本优势。开源星标只能说明关注度，不能证明付费需求或生产环境验证；若缺少清晰的使用场景、基准评测和分发渠道，项目可能停留在演示层。

en.highlight: A small, fast decision model for agentic workflows that picks between options or rates on a scale faster than an LLM, with calibrated confidence.
en.summary: This GitHub repository has 1,183 stars and recent public activity, describing a small, fast decision model or system model for agentic workflows. It is meant to choose between options or rate on a scale faster than an LLM, with calibrated confidence on each decision. It is worth reading as a signal of interest in lightweight decision components that could reduce latency and LLM calls in agent pipelines, though the available information is only the repository description.
en.failureAnalysis: Real agent tasks often need open-ended reasoning, so a narrow decider may be brittle on edge cases, out-of-distribution inputs, and multi-step decisions, and its calibrated confidence may not hold in production. Stars indicate attention, not validated demand; integration overhead, missing benchmarks, and unclear distribution could keep it at the demo stage.
en.title: A Small, Fast Decision Model for Agentic Workflows
